description: Verify that DUT ceases its claim and re-probes after Request + Reply conflicts on its committed Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §2.5, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Mixed-shape variant of _06/_07: first conflict is an ARP Request, the second is an ARP Reply. The always-cease branch must treat both as collision signals on the committed LL.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 1st Announce → post_claim entry observer fires:
   • UT-query DUT_LL → snapshot
   • Tester → DUT: 1 ARP Request, then 1 ARP Reply, both claiming committed LL

3. Observation (re-probe window):
   • DUT → wire: a fresh ARP Probe with target_proto_ip ≠ snapshotted committed LL   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Claim observed AND a fresh Probe with a different LL after the Request+Reply conflicts.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_claim_observed — DUT did not announce its committed LL
• Fail_no_reprobe — DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARPs

verdicts.Pass: DUT ceased and re-probed after Request+Reply conflicts — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_claim_observed: DUT did not announce its committed Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_no_reprobe: DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARPs
